parameters.name: sizePage
parameters.description: Items per page. Use `0` to retrieve only the count without fetching any item — faster when you only need the total.

parameters.name: referenceFeature
parameters.description: Filter by feature reference — returns at most one feature.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Filter by name, or by a portion of the name.

schema.description:
Type of a feature.

* `OnOff` — boolean feature (module access, content access, etc.)
* `Limitation` — counted feature whose quantity is NOT reset at renewal
* `Consumption` — counted feature whose quantity IS reset at each renewal
schema.title: TypeFeature

parameters.name: isVisible
parameters.description: Filter by visibility in offers and hosted pages.

schema.description:
Life state of a catalogue resource.

* `Ok` — active
* `ToModerate` — awaiting moderation
* `DisabledUser` — disabled by the user
* `DisabledSystem` — disabled by the system
* `DisabledModeration` — disabled after moderation
* `Deleted` — deleted
schema.title: StateLife

parameters.name: dateCreationMin
parameters.description: Created on or after this date.

parameters.name: dateCreationMax
parameters.description: Created on or before this date.

parameters.name: dateUpdateMin
parameters.description: Updated on or after this date.

parameters.name: dateUpdateMax
parameters.description: Updated on or before this date.

parameters.name: idUserCreation
parameters.description: Filter by the user who created the record.

parameters.name: idUserUpdate
parameters.description: Filter by the user who last updated the record.

parameters.name: extra
parameters.description: Sub-resources to embed in the response.
